description: Plano del Bus Berga is a dataset listed in IDEE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by busberga.ajberga.cat. The Berga Bus map is a set of cartographic information represented in a Instamaps viewer. The map contains the lines that represent the route of the bus routes, and the points that represent the stops of the urban routes. Coverage: ES. The portal shows the English title as "Berga bus map" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include Berga, Public transport, Avià, Municipi, Transporte público, Municipality. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-idee.
